event.text: Please go to the nearest emergency department or labour & delivery unit now — do not wait for a reply here. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself; if a safe ride cannot be arranged right away, call 911. A lasting headache with blurry vision and puffy hands and face in late pregnancy can signal a serious blood-pressure problem needing urgent blood pressure, urine and blood testing and fetal monitoring. If you have a seizure or lose consciousness, anyone with you should call 911 immediately; if severe belly pain or trouble breathing start on the way, call 911.
